T-3329: 1936 Prairie's belvedere stands back over a corbelled balcony, its cornice bracketed (#1637)

K08 lets a square tower take what the photograph shows on the Allerton house's
belvedere:
- `brackets` added by the record (the bracketed bay's consoles and modillions):
  consoles only at the ring's corners standing out of the wall, never inside
  the house, and under a moulded cornice's soffit where the eaves name one.
- `storey_balcony` at one storey line: a stone slab `out_m` proud whose top is
  that storey's floor, on stepped stone courses, under the flat top's stone
  balustrade (the same `_balcony` builder), closed square on the wall's plane
  at each cheek's end.

1936's tower: consoles at its two free corners and brackets 0.37 m apart under
the belvedere's cornice; a balcony at the belvedere's foot, 0.55 m out on a
0.3 m slab and three 0.16 m courses, with a 0.75 m balustrade. Sizes read
through the photograph's scale at the belvedere's lights; reconstructed.
Match record, liberty and sidecar updated; every other K01 mesh re-emitted
byte-identical. test_k01_tower: built case plus five refusals.

T-3336: a phone's Inspect inside a fort names the building looked at, not the stockade (#1639)

* T-3319: walk into Fort Dearborn through gates the Interact key opens

- The walker treats each fort stockade as its walls (curtain, bastions, and a
  span across each gateway while the gate is shut) instead of one solid
  footprint, and a parade ground as ground, so a visitor can walk inside in
  1812 and 1835; the buildings inside stay solid.
- fort-gates.js hangs each gate's two leaves on the jambs (planked, ledged and
  braced, swinging inward) in place of the baked shut pair; every gate starts
  shut.
- interact.js: a general interaction engine (states, actions as step
  sequences, prompt steps that wait for the next press) and the Interact key
  under Inspect (R on a keyboard). Only the fort gates use it for now.
- 1812: palisade gate_offset_m puts both picket rows' main gate on Whistler's
  passage, in the gap between the two halves of the soldiers' barracks;
  rebaked; the other palisades rebaked byte-identical for the generator hash.
- Liberty L-t3319-fort-gate-leaves; tools/test_fort_gates.mjs gated.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01YWBQdcX8Xzzup2FF7ZFEYy

* T-3320: Fort Dearborn's parade is trodden earth that feathers into the grass

The parade of both forts was the fort_structure archetype's flat 6 cm slab in one
colour, with a hard edge against the sward. It is now laid by the yards layer as the
apron's trodden_earth treatment on the parade's own footprint, fading into the grass
over 5 m (a record may now state ground.feather_m), and buildings.js leaves the slab
out. The grounds are generated from the parade records by
tools/generate_fort_parade_ground.py and re-derived by check.sh; 1812 reads its own
enclosure folder (scene enclosures_dir) holding only its parade ground.
Liberty L-t3320-parade-ground.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01YWBQdcX8Xzzup2FF7ZFEYy

* T-3320: smoke measures a fort parade as ground, not as a structure's box

The parade's earth body is now laid by the yards layer, so only the sun-dial
is drawn from its GLB; the size checks skip parade records and instead assert
each parade's centre reads trodden_earth.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01YWBQdcX8Xzzup2FF7ZFEYy

* T-3320: the drawn-placement census treats a fort parade like a sparse plot

Its GLB now draws only the sun-dial, so the parade's footprint reference need
not be occupied; its vertices still owe the millimetre transform check.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01YWBQdcX8Xzzup2FF7ZFEYy

* T-3320: re-derive liberty and source-use counts after merging dev

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01YWBQdcX8Xzzup2FF7ZFEYy

* Lap onto dev: generated files regenerated, not merged

The five files a tool owns conflict on every merge and are never hand-merged —
ticket.mjs board, publish.sh and compile_scene rewrite them from source. Nothing
in this branch's own diff was touched.

Merge drivers registered from dev rather than from this branch, so a branch cut
before T-0831 resolves the same way one cut after it does (T-0857).

* T-3336: a phone's Inspect inside a fort names the building looked at, not the stockade

The phone's Inspect probe answers from building parts' boxes (boxPick). A
stockade is one part whose box holds the whole fort, and a ray starting inside a
box was answered at 0 m, so inside either fort the pickets always won. boxPick
now measures a box the eye stands in at the ray's exit, so a building in front
is nearer; with nothing nearer ahead the stockade is still answered. The draw
cull (drawPick) keeps the old reading.
